original_test_intent: Enumerate and decode supported authentication, integrity and confidentiality algorithms/cipher suites for one approved BMC channel and compare them with the security baseline without changing configuration.
original_method: Run App 0x06/0x54 for the selected channel with preserved 0x00/0x80 list selector and bounded list index traversal.
manual_activity: Security owner supplies the approved channel, supported list modes and cipher-suite policy once; no per-run mutation approval is required.
safety_requirements: Do not put password in argv/evidence
Bound index and detect continuation loops
Do not modify channel security or keys
agent_execution_scope: Archive redacted raw and decoded evidence
engineer_actions: Approve security baseline and parser once

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is too restrictive: the Master already supplies the standard command and list selector values, though it correctly lacks Project expected results.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected runner to traverse the approved 0x06/0x54 list mode with strict page/index bounds, decode all records and compare with the security baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw command, channel placeholder, 0x00/0x80 list meanings, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved; missing acceptance is added only in review.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform deterministic bounded cipher-suite enumeration with continuation-loop protection, full decoding and policy comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds response semantics and meaningful acceptance beyond no command error without changing the source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Successful completion alone does not prove the suite list is complete, correctly decoded or compliant; a high-level cipher listing is equivalent only if it covers the same records.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Parser or traversal errors can produce a false security assessment, while the inventory can disclose management security capability.

project_override_considerations: A vendor or ipmitool high-level cipher inventory is equivalent only if it covers both approved list semantics, all continuation pages and identical algorithm fields; raw 0x54 coverage remains explicit if skipped.
expected_evidence: Verified target/channel/list scope and security baseline
Policy comparison and bounded traversal audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The command and list-selector notes align with the title. The Criteria is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only operation is explicit. Channel, parser and expected security baseline are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Upgrades a no-error-only criterion into complete, bounded cipher-suite enumeration and security-policy validation without authorizing automatic reconfiguration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cipher-suite discovery is a paged record problem: a zero completion on one index can miss later suites or misinterpret algorithm identifiers. The validator must enforce finite traversal and decode each authentication, integrity and confidentiality component before comparing policy, especially because a reported suite may be syntactically valid yet prohibited by the project baseline.
